reason: The quote states customers will never incur request fees or data transfer charges for requests blocked by AWS WAF; the claim's note that WAF's own charges are out of scope only narrows the claim and asserts nothing the quote does not say.

The four quotes carry the Source IP setting, the 2-tuple of source and destination IP, routing to the same endpoint whenever they connect, and the caveat that traffic shifting to an edge location preferring a different Region means affinity is not guaranteed.

The quotes give routing back to healthy endpoints with non-zero dials typically in about 30 seconds, that established connections are not moved, and that they stay on the zero-weight Region until reset by client or server or a new connection.
